table_title: List the 15 wide-body commercial aircraft built/produced families per Wikipedia's `Wide-body aircraft` master article's comparison table — twin-aisle commercial passenger jets. Universe per cycle-1 audit's BLOCKING #2 lock: 15 built/produced models (EXCLUDES Comac C929 because it is projected with 2029- first-flight + no Number Built value — only 16th row in master table). Schema per cycle-1 audit's BLOCKING #1 pivot: initial Manufacturer + First Flight Year + Capacity + Service Status were NOT master-supported (would have required per-aircraft page extraction); pivoted to master-supported {Model + Produced + MTOW (tonnes) + Length + Number Built}. Range / compound cells kept as text per cycle-1 audit SUGGESTION #1 — matches master table verbatim. Produced cell captures production date range + service status without curator interpretation (per cycle-1 audit SUGGESTION #2 — Produced replaces Service Status).
db_analog: SELECT model_name, produced_range, mtow_tonnes, length_compound, number_built_marker FROM wiki_wide_body_aircraft_comparison_table WHERE is_built_or_produced AND number_built_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY model_name ASC
temporal_note: Wikipedia `Wide-body aircraft` master article's comparison table, accessed via cycle-1 audit's master-derived 15-row dump on 2026-05-20. Universe is the closed canonical 15-entry built/produced wide-body commercial aircraft set — twin-aisle passenger jet families with documented production counts. Per cycle-1 audit BLOCKING #2: master table has 16 rows total; Comac C929 (16th row) is EXCLUDED because it's projected (2029- first-flight, no Number Built value); staged universe = 15 built/produced families. Per cycle-1 audit BLOCKING #1: schema pivoted from initially-proposed Manufacturer + First Flight Year + Capacity + Service Status (NOT master-supported — would have required 15 per-aircraft Wikipedia page extraction) to master-supported {Model + Produced + MTOW (tonnes) + Length + Number Built}. Per cycle-1 audit SUGGESTION #1: range/compound cells kept as text matching master table verbatim. Per cycle-1 audit SUGGESTION #2: Produced cell (year range + present/end marker) replaces Service Status — captures production status without curator interpretation. source_count = 1 registered (Wikipedia Wide-body aircraft master article comparison table — universe + value role for all 5 cells per cycle-1 audit's master-supported schema). Per-row cells: Model name verbatim from master (e.g., 'Airbus A300', 'Boeing 747', 'McDonnell Douglas DC-10' — manufacturer + numeric model designation); Produced text with en-dash year range + 'present' or end-year marker (e.g., '1974–2007' for retired A300, '1994–present' for in-production A330, '1992-present' for Il-96 — note Il-96 uses hyphen not en-dash per master verbatim); MTOW (tonnes) text with numeric or numeric-range value (Boeing 777 has range '351.5–365.7' for variants); Length text compound with metric + imperial parenthetical (e.g., '53.61–54.08 m (175 ft 11 in – 177 ft 5 in)' for A300); Number Built text with numeric value + status/date marker (e.g., '561 (discontinued)' for A300, '1663 (March 2026)' for A330, '34 (2025)' for Il-96). temporal_sensitivity = medium — Number Built values for in-production aircraft (A330, A350, Boeing 767, 777, 787) update annually with new deliveries; Produced cells update when production ends.
_extraction_notes: Multi_attribute_projection instance — closed canonical 15-entry built/produced wide-body commercial aircraft universe per Wikipedia `Wide-body aircraft` master article's comparison table. Single PK Model (15 closed values). **NEW `vehicles/*` entity bucket added** (pkdb_bench grows from 13 to 14 entity buckets — joining countries / subnational-regions / cities-and-capitals / people / physical-features / engineered-structures / events / artifacts / abstract-categories / taxonomic-entities / organizations / time-periods / agricultural-commodities). NEW `vehicles/aircraft` fine-class. Chips `multi_attribute_projection` category from 7 staged (under raised target 102 ceiling = gap-3) → 8 staged → closer to raised-ceiling saturation. Source plan: 1 registered source (Wikipedia Wide-body aircraft master article comparison table — universe + value role for all 5 cells per cycle-1 audit's master-supported schema BLOCKING fix). claim_type = source_defined per cycle-1 audit confirmation; master-supported schema preserves source_defined cleanly + source_count=1 honestly. Cycle arc: 1 round of pre-staging design review (cycle-1 'Revise' with 3 BLOCKING — schema must pivot to master-supported attributes + universe must explicitly decide projected aircraft inclusion + source_count=1 honest only under master-supported schema; + 2 SUGGESTION — range/compound cells as text + Produced replaces Service Status). All cycle-1 fixes applied at cycle-0 staging using audit's verbatim 15-row dump. 5-cell schema (Model PK + Produced + MTOW + Length + Number Built) at 15 rows = 75 source-grounded cell values. Sort: Model ASC alphabetic (multi_attribute_projection convention — mirror russell_group precedent). Confidence gradient: very-LLM-knowable include Boeing 747 (1968–2023 iconic Queen of the Skies), Airbus A380 (2005–2021 superjumbo), Boeing 787 Dreamliner (2007–present composite-airframe), Airbus A330 + A350 (in-production); mid-difficulty include Lockheed L-1011 TriStar (1972–1985), McDonnell Douglas DC-10 (1971–1989 with cargo-door + DC-10-10/30/40 variants); harder calibration include Ilyushin Il-86 (1980–1994 only 106 built — Soviet wide-body), Ilyushin Il-96 (1992-present limited production 34 built — Russia's only currently-produced wide-body); exact Number Built values at thousands-precision (1663 for A330 / 1574 for 747 / 1786 for 777). Multi_attribute_projection category-fit: per the category contract, the row universe has 4 attributes projected per aircraft (Produced + MTOW + Length + Number Built) without aggregation or partitioning. Mirror precedent `russell_group_universities_attributes` (multi_attribute_projection, organizations/universities) + `twentieth_century_us_presidents_attributes` (multi_attribute_projection, people/politicians) + `fifty_us_states_attributes` (multi_attribute_projection, subnational-regions/us-states). Range/compound text cells novel — first vehicles-bucket instance + first to use compound-imperial-metric Length cells systematically (mirror precedent for text-range cells: largest_sauropods_by_estimated_mass which used text ranges for estimate uncertainty).
